name: plan-specs
about: Test plan through the plan_specs bot: the 4th specializations (mods/specs) cast in an emptied Bandit Keep floor at level 20. winddancer: Protective Gale puts gale_1 (Evasion, 6 s, HUD icon) on the rogue; an evade (the evade verb: Player.Evade's real roll) heals 20 through Second Wind, a second within 4 s does not; the orbs' binds take (Lasting Gale 12 s, Tailwind, Lingering Breeze, Shared Breath), the recast lasts 12 s with Tailwind's speed, a gust gives breeze_2, and the rogue never gets the teammates' share buff. bannerlord: the raise gives standard_dr at 2%, Feared Crest and War Drum debuff a dummy, Shared Provisions counts the buff; the second press plants it for free at 4%. invocation: Tempest Torrent zaps all three dummies in a row; the orbs' binds take; 3 Static Charge stacks (the stacks verb) give conduit_2_3; at 5 the next cast releases them (stacks 0) and Static Channel gives 20% mana back; the 5 s torrent with Thunderclap hurts all three again.
